description.value: Floatplane service connecting Vancouver, Victoria, Nanaimo, Salt Spring Island, and other coastal BC destinations. Bikes accepted on a space-available basis; remove the front wheel so it fits in the luggage area. $20 handling fee; the bike's weight counts toward your baggage allowance; no trailers. Certain aircraft (the Twin Otter) can't carry a bike, so contact Harbour Air before booking.

Accommodates bicycles.detail: Bikes in luggage area with front wheel removed; space-available; some aircraft can't take bikes

Bike fee applies.detail: $20 handling fee; bike weight counts toward your baggage allowance
